vectors.name: sgr-colon-truecolor
vectors.description: Colon-separated SGR truecolor (ITU T.416) must not leak parameters as text.

vectors.name: cursor-movement
vectors.description: CUP, CUU, CUD, CUF, CUB place text at exact cells.

vectors.name: erase-line
vectors.description: EL 0 and EL 1 erase right of and left of the cursor.

vectors.name: rep-repeat-char
vectors.description: REP (CSI Ps b) repeats the preceding graphic character. Known xterm.js gap.

vectors.name: decaln-alignment
vectors.description: DECALN (ESC # 8) fills the screen with E. Known xterm.js gap.

vectors.name: sync-output-2026
vectors.description: Synchronized Output (DEC private mode 2026): bracketed output still renders in full.

vectors.name: sync-output-decrqm
vectors.description: DECRQM for mode 2026 reports recognised-and-reset (2), the signal TUIs use to detect Synchronized Output support.

vectors.name: kitty-keyboard-query
vectors.description: Kitty keyboard protocol query (CSI ? u) answers with the current flags (0). Known xterm.js gap.

vectors.name: wide-chars
vectors.description: CJK and emoji occupy two cells and do not shift following text.

vectors.name: combining-mark
vectors.description: A combining acute accent shares the base character's cell.

vectors.name: scroll-region
vectors.description: DECSTBM confines LF and RI scrolling to rows 2-4.

vectors.name: alt-screen
vectors.description: Mode 1049 swaps to a clean alternate screen and restores the main screen and cursor.

vectors.name: insert-delete
vectors.description: ICH, DCH, IL edit in place without losing neighbours.

vectors.name: osc-title-hyperlink
vectors.description: OSC 0/2 titles and OSC 8 hyperlinks (BEL and ST terminated) print nothing extra.

vectors.name: autowrap
vectors.description: DECAWM on wraps at the margin; off overwrites the last column.

vectors.name: cursor-position-report
vectors.description: DSR 6 answers CSI row;col R for the current cursor.

vectors.name: backspace-cr
vectors.description: BS moves left without erasing and CR returns to column 1.

vectors.name: full-reset
vectors.description: RIS (ESC c) clears the screen and homes the cursor.
